description:
List the integrations connected to your workspace, with each one's `id` and `integration_type`. Stored credentials (tokens, secrets, passwords, API keys, and the values of a custom API's headers and parameters) are never returned: they read `********`. When you create an integration, send the real values: `********` is refused. Accounts that sign in with OAuth (Google Sheets, Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho Bigin) are connected in the dashboard.
(Tags: Integrations)
name: listIntegrations
